## HaloBar 0.0.9

### New
- **A full audio mixer** in Quick settings. Every app on every output, with live level meters, its own output device, and the microphone's volume and mute. No virtual audio devices needed.
- **Mixer groups.** Up to 8, each with a name, color and icon. Set volume, mute and output for the whole group, with each app still adjustable inside it.
- **Chat mix, ducking and profiles.** Balance game against chat, lower chosen groups while another plays, and save mixes to switch between.
- **Mixer shortcuts** with an on-screen note: Ctrl+Alt+M mutes the mic, Ctrl+Alt+P picks the next profile, Ctrl+Alt+[ and ] move the chat mix, and Ctrl+Alt+1 to 8 mute a group.
- **Shared with Astraeus.** Groups, profiles and options are the same in both apps, and only one of them applies the mix at a time.
- **Visualizer opacity.** One slider for how see-through the player's visualizer is, shared with Astraeus. It replaces the album art strength slider; the art now shows at full strength.

### Better
- **The mixer page opens reliably** from Quick settings.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
